title: The Vanished Geisha Beans
scene: At 9:20 AM, the rare Geisha beans vanished from the tasting bar. A full roast cycle in the drum roaster takes 35 minutes.

suspects.name: Samira Haddad
suspects.testimony: I wiped espresso wands right beside the tasting bar from 9:05 to 9:25 AM.
suspects.alibiProof: Two morning regulars watched Samira cleaning the espresso bar from 9:05 to 9:25 AM.

suspects.name: Jasper Flynn
suspects.testimony: I loaded green beans into the drum roaster at 9:00 AM and bagged the finished roast at 9:20 AM.
suspects.contradiction: A 35-minute roast started at 9:00 AM finishes at 9:35 AM, and the Geisha tin was in Jasper's locker.

suspects.name: Audrey Blake
suspects.testimony: I reviewed invoices in the loft office from 9:00 to 9:25 AM and never came downstairs.
suspects.alibiProof: The loft camera shows Audrey typing at her desk continuously from 9:00 to 9:25 AM.

suspects.name: Rafael Costa
suspects.testimony: I glazed cinnamon rolls in the pastry nook from 9:05 to 9:30 AM, keeping the oven warm.
suspects.alibiProof: The delivery driver tasted one of Rafael's rolls in the pastry nook at 9:15 and 9:25 AM.
